messages:
Hannah Cole: Opening a small PR to correct the on-prem installer docs around KMS certificate rotation and to add an SDK snippet for checking vendor HSM thumbprints. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/1428 :mag:

docs-deploy-bot: PR created by Hannah Cole: redwood-inference/docs #1428 (CI queued)

Ethan Brooks: Thanks Hannah. Two asks: 1) add the exact openssl command we recommend for customers to verify HSM certs, 2) include a short migration note for sites that used static host entries.

Mateo Silva: Suggested openssl example:
`openssl s_client -connect 10.5.5.10:1792 -servername kms.hsm.internal -showcerts | openssl x509 -noout -fingerprint -sha256`
Also add an SDK snippet to verify the certificate thumbprint before establishing a PKCS#11 session.

Hannah Cole: Pasting an inline SDK JS pseudocode example to include in docs:
`const certFingerprint = await fetchFingerprint('10.5.5.10'); if (certFingerprint !== expected) throw new Error('HSM fingerprint mismatch'); // proceed to initialize pkcs11`
Will refine wording and push to PR.

Ethan Brooks: For migration steps: 1) remove /etc/hosts entries that map kms.hsm.internal, 2) enable installer flag `--resolver-mode=stub`, 3) apply CoreDNS forwarders, 4) run the openssl thumbprint check. Add a rollback step: re-add host entry and open a support ticket with attachable debug output.

Mateo Silva: Also include a small CoreDNS forwarder example and note to keep denial cache low for HSM names (20s). Example:
`.:1053 { forward kms.hsm.internal 10.5.5.10 10.5.5.11 forward . 1.1.1.1 tls_servername=dot.upstream.example cache { success 600 denial 20 } log }`

docs-deploy-bot: CI passed for #1428  link/linters OK.

Hannah Cole: Merged after minor wording edits and adding a changelog entry referencing `--resolver-mode=stub`. Thanks all!
